name: The Waking
summary: The Shards are stirring and the expeditions are going wrong. Get the party through the gate and see for yourself.

gate.summary: The gate road east of the yard is sealed. Find what opens it.

objectives.text: Pull the relay lever on the gate road
Reach the end of the road

relay.summary: Crew Halden went east to the relay station three days ago and did not come back. Find them.

objectives.text: Reach the relay station east of the road
Find out what happened to Crew Halden

deeper.summary: The log says the singing starts at the second depth. Reach it and come back.
deeper.next_toast: Pell keeps the light on at the relay station. Three more crews went down after Halden; she has their last positions.

expeditions.summary: Three crews went down after Halden: Ostrand, Vane, Marrow. All Beacon-crew, all humming when they left. Pell at the relay station has their last positions; the Shards have the rest.
expeditions.next_toast: Something is singing under the yard. The throat has opened south of the plaza road.

objectives.text: Get the crews' last positions from Pell

throat.summary: Something is singing under the yard. The Undercity throat has opened south of the plaza road, and it goes down further than the yard does.

objectives.text: Enter the Undercity throat from the yard
Get past whatever holds the throat
Follow the singing down into the flooded gallery
Silence the cantor in the gallery
Reach the source of the singing

choir.summary: First contact. It knew your name, and it told you the Sundering was a choice. Act 1 ends here; on the plaza, three envoys are waiting for an answer.
